production_O3_review.compile_portability_scope: GCC13.3 scratch O2/O1 compilation/execution is proven. Production O3, Ubuntu22.04 GCC11 and other compiler/architecture builds have not been executed with this candidate. The new intrinsic families require only the explicitly guarded AVX512F/DQ plus existing AVX2/FMA features.
production_O3_review.conclusion: No source-level O3 blocker found. The narrow candidate is suitable for integrated compilation and unchanged model/performance qualification; this is a review judgment, not an executed O3 result.
production_O3_review.dispatch: Every AVX512 entry point is target-attributed with avx512f,avx512dq,avx2,fma. The generic dispatcher requires all four through the existing compiler runtime-feature mechanism before selecting avx512_fma. No global AVX512 compiler flag or unconditional wide entry was added.
production_O3_review.fallbacks: AVX2/FMA, AArch64 NEON and scalar selection remain. A residual eight-lane block reuses AVX2, and fewer than eight remaining values use scalar_range. The scalar diagnostic override is unchanged.
production_O3_review.grouping: The current production command enables O3 without fast-math. Explicit activation FMA intrinsics retain the existing grouping. GCC optimize(fp-contract=off) on the update and scalar functions, and the existing Clang fp contract(off) pragma, preserve separate state products/add; the candidate follows the existing AVX2 controls.
production_O3_review.recommendation: Apply only the narrow two-file AVX512 candidate after the current source/build hold is released, then let the unchanged integrated build and full qualification decide acceptance. Keep adaptive tiling unapplied.
remaining_material_risks: Full production compilation and original-reference model gates have not run with this candidate.
AVX512 frequency and throughput effects depend on the actual CPU, so no speed benefit is established.
NaN payload/sign and floating-point exception flags are outside the exact-bit promise; NaN classification and signed-zero behavior are covered.
An actually AVX512-incapable host and AArch64 NEON were not executed in these x86 controls; their existing code paths remain.

read_only_review.dispatch: Target attributes and runtime checks both require AVX512F, AVX512DQ, AVX2 and FMA; existing AVX2, NEON and scalar fallbacks are retained.
read_only_review.finite_fma_grouping: 16-lane exceptional-exp participation changes an ordinary lane from FMA(j,k,k) to FMA(k,j,k); finite product/add rounding is equivalent and exact-bit controls passed.
read_only_review.tail: One AVX2 block handles an 8..15-element remainder, followed by the unchanged scalar remainder; individual gate-plane bounds are preserved.
read_only_review.tanh_and_cell: The polynomial coefficients, clamps, signed-zero and NaN restoration, plus separate state products/add are unchanged.
